policy.assertion: C10 removes the universal two-correction business stop; separates recoveries/research/model corrections, requires evidence-backed next action and stops unproductive or unauthorized paths without declaring the whole goal complete.

Search is planned by decision/question and expected evidence, with alternate hypotheses, primary verification, conflict/missing-evidence handling, raw-source isolation and compact context; no query-count substitute for coverage or source quality.

Smoke/acceptance remains tied to original mandatory outputs and actual checks; progress policy does not excuse missing evidence, edit frozen history, reset counters, or bypass explicit tool/permission refusal.

independent_review.assertion: Fresh reviewer receives original user goal, frozen candidate and raw neutral scenarios only; produces source/observation-backed decisions and falsifiable requirement verdicts without author diagnoses.

Review covers >2 justified recovery/lookup actions, repeated no-information action, conflicting source, external instruction contamination, actual hard stop and legacy frozen-case semantics; optional improvements separated from mandatory defects.

research_trial.assertion: A usable question-to-decision search plan exists before actual web retrieval; queries/routes are adapted to observed gaps and bias, sources checked in primary passages.

Actual multi-step search/open trajectory, retained/discarded-source rationale and supported synthesis are recorded; compact working context excludes irrelevant raw text, instruction payloads and duplicate reposts.

Actual scope, resource window, tool errors if any, missing evidence and telemetry limits retained; more than two useful steps do not falsely imply >2 actual corrections, no unbounded exact repeats or unsupported capability claim.

delivery.assertion: Meaningful legacy/new controller guards and immutable byte/history checks pass; source and independent behavior conclusions separated.
Freshly unpacked C10 package contains only locked Markdown, with byte comparisons; TODO/checkpoint/entry policy reflect current user change without changing old verdicts.

limits: Scenario examination is a controlled judgment test, not proof of live tool recovery. Actual search supports only this observed task, not general accuracy or competition quality.
policy: The p1-p3 array governs policy review; no fixed global corrective count under the new user policy. Explicit legacy experimental limits and real host restrictions remain.
